result:
I’d make people truly capable of understanding each other’s inner lives — not just noticing behavior, but feeling what it’s like to be another person.

Not by forcing kindness or overriding free will. Just by making “I only know my side” feel rare. That would reduce a lot of cruelty, fear, and pointless conflict, while making connection, disagreement, and intimacy more honest.
